summary_plain_english: The DELETE /api/v1/items/{id} endpoint has been removed. The generated SDK clients (src/client/sdk.gen.ts and src/api/sdk.gen.ts) no longer expose a deleteItem method, and the corresponding TypeScript types are absent from both types.gen.ts files. The DeleteItem React component has been stubbed to return null, but ItemActionsMenu.tsx still imports and renders it, leaving a non-functional delete option in the item actions dropdown. The Playwright test suite (tests/items.spec.ts) has no delete test, so there is no automated guard against this regression.
patch_description: Repaired 7 files for removal of DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}: cleaned up the DeleteItem stub component, removed the DeleteItem import and JSX usage from ItemActionsMenu, and added a Playwright test asserting the delete menu action is absent. The four generated SDK/types files (src/client/sdk.gen.ts, src/api/sdk.gen.ts, src/client/types.gen.ts, src/api/types.gen.ts) were already free of any itemsDeleteItem references and required no changes.
verify_log: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors (type contract verified). npm run build: production bundle compiled cleanly in 820ms (vite v8.3.1, 2370 modules transformed).
